caption: The CII emergency response flowchart shows reporting paths for mechanical or engineering emergencies, fire or explosion incidents, and security incidents. Each path escalates to the Property Manager and then to the Board of Directors or the developer representative.
This screenshot shows the Oracle Applications Cloud reset-password screen with fields for a new password and password confirmation, followed by a Submit button.

This image is a formal policy announcement from the CII Tower Management Board regarding a no-smoking rule within the building. It specifies that smoking is strictly prohibited in all areas, including offices, lobbies, elevators, hallways, restrooms, and entrances. The document also outlines a fine of 500,000 VND per violation for tenants who fail to comply.

This image is an official announcement from the CII Tower management regarding the implementation of bicycle parking fees. It outlines the specific daily and monthly costs for bicycle parking, as well as the building's maximum capacity of 25 bicycle slots.

This image displays a formal notification or policy excerpt from the CII Tower management, featuring the OBI and CBRE logos at the top. It provides contact information for the building management office via email and hotline for questions regarding service quality. The document is officially validated with a red corporate seal and the signature of the Property Manager.
